observations.title: Consult Engram before every job
observations.content: fact: Before processing any user request, run engram search rule --project global and optionally --project <project_name>. If unreachable, note and continue. topics: [startup, engram, rule]

observations.title: Project scope isolation mandatory
observations.content: fact: While working in a project, Atlas stays in .projects/<project_name>/ scope. Do not cross project boundaries unless user explicitly asks. topics: [scope, project, isolation]

observations.title: Read SKILL.md before executing any skill
observations.content: fact: Before delegating to any skill, use read_file on the skill SKILL.md. Never assume skill behavior. Path: .github/skills/<skill_id>/SKILL.md. topics: [skill, delegation, rule]

observations.title: Engram content hard limit 300 chars
observations.content: fact: Every engram save must have content under 300 characters. Split long notes into multiple atomic memories. Never store raw tool logs. topics: [engram, memory, rule]

observations.title: No hallucination: label uncertain points
observations.content: fact: Atlas must not assert without evidence. Any uncertain point must be labeled as missing evidence. If evidence is missing or context was compacted, request a second run. topics: [evidence, hallucination, rule]

observations.title: Atlas workspace root structure
observations.content: fact: Atlas Lite workspace root: .github/ (config+skills), .projects/ (project instances), engram.exe (binary), installer/windows/. topics: [structure, workspace, architecture]

observations.title: Project template location and folders
observations.content: fact: Project template at .projects/_template/. New projects created from this template. Folders: context/, openspec/, reports/, work/. topics: [project, template, structure]

observations.title: OpenSpec path is mandatory
observations.content: fact: OpenSpec path must be .projects/<project_name>/openspec/. Use for expanded reasoning and long-form docs. No size limit. topics: [openspec, memory, project]

observations.title: SDD dependency graph is strict
observations.content: fact: SDD graph: proposal->specs->tasks->apply->verify->archive. design supports specs before tasks. Never skip steps. topics: [sdd, workflow, dependency]

observations.title: SDD command to skill mapping
observations.content: fact: /sdd-init->sdd-init, /sdd-explore->sdd-explore, /sdd-new->explore+propose, /sdd-ff->propose+spec+design+tasks, /sdd-apply->sdd-apply. topics: [sdd, commands, mapping]

observations.title: sdd-continue selects next needed step
observations.content: fact: /sdd-continue selects next from: sdd-spec, sdd-design, sdd-tasks based on what exists in .projects/<project_name>/work/. topics: [sdd, continue, workflow]

observations.title: Skill output envelope is mandatory
observations.content: fact: Every skill phase must return: status, executive_summary, artifacts, next_recommended, risks. Reject partial outputs. topics: [skill, envelope, output]

observations.title: Basic skill tiers catalog
observations.content: fact: Basic tiers: sdd(9), data_engineering(5), data_science(3), business_intelligence(4). Try basic first before extended families. topics: [skills, catalog, tier]

observations.title: Skill expansion scoring threshold
observations.content: fact: Score: mandate_overlap+40, io_compat+25, domain_keywords+20, quality_gates+15. Use candidate if score>=70, else create new skill. topics: [skills, expansion, scoring]

observations.title: Never delete existing skills
observations.content: fact: Never delete skills during expansion. Changes must be additive and reversible. Register new skills in atlas-skill-catalog.json. topics: [skills, governance, expansion]

observations.title: Engram project field is mandatory
observations.content: fact: Engram project field required always. global=cross-project. <project_name>=project-specific. Never save with null project. topics: [engram, project, field]

observations.title: Engram observation type taxonomy
observations.content: fact: Valid types: decision|policy|regulation|pattern|bugfix|incident|discovery|learning|runbook|risk|rule. Always use correct type. topics: [engram, type, taxonomy]

observations.title: Engram noise control is strict
observations.content: fact: Save only: decisions, conventions, findings, incidents, rules. Never store raw tool logs or command outputs. topics: [engram, noise, discipline]

observations.title: Non-programmer first communication rule
observations.content: fact: Always explain in plain language. Avoid jargon or define it in one line. Answer: what changed, why it matters, what is next. topics: [audience, communication, ux]

observations.title: Safety operations hard constraints
observations.content: fact: Never run mass destructive edits without explicit user approval. Never invent skill IDs. Ask one clarification if requirement is ambiguous. topics: [safety, operations, rule]

observations.title: Rule override scope boundary
observations.content: fact: Project rules may override global defaults only inside that project scope. Global rules always apply outside project context. topics: [rules, override, scope]

observations.title: Engram seed location for releases
observations.content: fact: Engram seed at installer/windows/engram-seed.json. install-atlas.ps1 calls engram import on this file. Update before each release. topics: [installer, seed, engram]

observations.title: Engram binary and DB locations
observations.content: fact: engram.exe at workspace root. DB at C:/Users/<user>/.engram/engram.db. ENGRAM_DATA_DIR env var overrides DB path. topics: [engram, binary, path]
